vascular_dataset_big_images.unit_of_annotation: one image, no case or patient column at all
vascular_dataset_big_images.why: three reasons, each sufficient. (1) The label set is 5 weak fields; none of clarity / exudation / malformation_ratio is present, so it cannot extend either deliverable field. (2) There is no case or patient column -- 582 rows are 582 images, so cases cannot be formed without inventing a grouping, and a grouping we invent leaks. (3) 161 of 582 are perceptually identical to stills already in our archives and 287 more sit within hamming 24; the residue that survived multi-scale template matching against all 2207 of our stills is 32 images, which is not 50-100 cases under any grouping.

hf_capillary_dataset.why: it has subjects (103 people per the published count) but carries none of our 21 fields -- its only case-level label is diabetes, which our own audit showed is device-confounded (file-extension AUROC 0.9963, patient-level clarity AUROC 1.000 with zero overlap). Its boxes are already used as A2x's detector pre-training; boxes are not field labels.

anfc_thu.image_size: 640x640 for all 321 -- already tiled/resized by Roboflow
anfc_thu.why: box-level categories only, no report fields, and no way to reach a case-level value for clarity / exudation / malformation_ratio. The 68 session prefixes are not people with our labels.

mendeley_ssc.why: no clinical table ships with it, so no field values at all. Our earlier audit found all 576/576 carry device caliper markings, which also rules them out as appearance training data. Filenames embed dates and apparent personal names -- any use needs re-keying to opaque ids first.
mendeley_ssc.privacy_note: filenames contain apparent patient names; none recorded here

captures_app.content: report.json holds MODEL predictions with status=predicted*
captures_app.why: these are our own model's outputs (model_version siglip2-naflex-multisource-v3-20260802). Using them as labels would be training on our own predictions.

training_material_微循环培训资料.why: teaching clips illustrate a phenomenon by name (e.g. 红细胞严重聚集) but are not examinations of a person with our 21 fields, and flow-state fields are already closed for needing a time base we cannot calibrate.
